estimate_justification: Two sequential resident model loads and twenty measured requests with two excluded warmups, followed by at most twenty fresh server loads and their warmups and requests. Startup and request caps are 300 and 120 seconds. Budget includes release and sealing.
decision_rule: QUESTION: Can the pinned v10 CPU image versus itself produce sealed resident and fresh lifecycle evidence, and does exact request, full response content and token-ID parity hold within scheduled opposite-arm pairs and across lifecycle at the same schedule key? Stop on answer when the sealed evidence and all observations are available. Stop on futility for missing input, identity, topology, cleanup or exhausted grant. Clean resident failure replays the identical plan on fresh servers and preserves the failure. Missing token IDs are diagnostic incomplete; observed differences are diagnostic mismatch. Observation only. Strict native adapter replay is required; no promotion authority.
